customProcessing.status: unmeasured: dispatch includes AppKit and app work

captureBaseline.openBoundary: Before controller hotkey handler to visible first-line area, focus, first synthetic key in view/model, and displayIfNeeded completion; animation may still be running.
captureBaseline.typingBoundary: Before window.sendEvent to return (dispatch), then displayIfNeeded completion (draw proxy). Excludes OS input queue and compositor/display scanout.
captureBaseline.visibleLatency: Unmeasured. Draw completion is only a proxy; use signposts plus Instruments/video on physical hardware.
